evidence.title: WORK INSTRUCTION WI-1997-02
evidence.claim: In 1997, the 5-minute empty run for D-1 was introduced to warm hydraulic oil and prevent seal failures.
evidence.quote: run D-1 empty for 5 minutes before charging, to bring the hydraulic oil to working temperature

evidence.title: MAINTENANCE LOG - DISPERSER D-1 (extract 1996)
evidence.claim: In 1996, repeated seal failures on D-1 led a technician to recommend running the drive without load to warm the oil.
evidence.quote: hydraulic oil too viscous below 15 °C, recommends running the drive without load until the oil is warm

evidence.title: Equipment modification EQ-2019-002 - disperser D-1 drive
evidence.claim: In 2019, the hydraulic drive of D-1 was replaced by an electric motor, removing the hydraulic circuit entirely.
evidence.quote: The hydraulic drive unit of D-1 has been removed and replaced by a direct-coupled 45 kW electric motor
